extracted.intended_audience: USPTO leadership, policymakers, congressional oversight, IP stakeholders, patent and trademark practitioners, and the interested public
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and describes the USPTO's formal performance measures, statutory compliance metrics, and related definitional standards used to evaluate patent and trademark program performance in the FY2023 Annual Performance Report / FY2025 Annual Performance Plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility patent eligibility (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Utility patents may be granted to anyone who invents or discovers any new and useful process, machine, article of manufacture (AofM), or composition of matter, or any new and useful improvement thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the statutory subject-matter categories for utility patents and scope of what may be claimed; points users to the Patent Basics webpage for application and maintenance procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design patent eligibility (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Design patents may be granted to anyone who invents a new, original, and ornamental design for an Article of Manufacture (AofM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the qualifying standard for design patents (new, original, ornamental); refers readers to Patent Basics for more information on procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant patent eligibility (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Plant patents may be granted to anyone who invents or discovers and asexually reproduces any distinct and new variety of plant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the eligibility criteria for plant patents (distinct, new variety and asexual reproduction).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade secret definition (three elements)
rubrics_metrics.description: A trade secret is information that (1) has actual or potential independent economic value by virtue of not being generally known, (2) has value to others who cannot legitimately obtain the information, and (3) is subject to reasonable efforts to maintain its secrecy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All three elements are required; loss of any element means the trade secret ceases to exist. No temporal limit on protection while elements are maintained. Points to USPTO trade secrets / regulatory data protection webpage for more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent timeliness goals (PTA-based)
rubrics_metrics.description: The USPTO established patent timeliness goals based on Patent Term Adjustment (PTA), i.e., the agency’s overall adherence to statutorily defined time frames.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reducing issued PTAs provides consistently short patent prosecution timelines; agency sets targets and monitors PTA compliance as the basis for timeliness measurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Total Patent Term Adjustment (PTA) Compliance - Mailed Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: KPI measuring PTA compliance for mailed actions (percent compliance against statutory timelines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table shows historical actuals, targets, FY2023 actual (81.0%) and status (Exceeded). Used to track adherence to statutorily defined timeframes for mailed office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Total PTA Compliance - Remaining Inventory
rubrics_metrics.description: KPI measuring PTA compliance for the remaining inventory of patent files (percent compliance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tableed with historical targets and results; FY2023 actual (82.0%) and status (Not Met). Monitors PTA performance across uncompleted inventory, not just mailed actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent statutory compliance metric — 35 U.S.C. §101 (utility/eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure evaluating statutory compliance on Section 101 (including utility and eligibility determinations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a percent compliance KPI with targets and actuals (e.g., FY2023 actual 98.2% vs target 94.0%). Used to assess examiner decisions for conformity with Section 101 requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent statutory compliance metric — 35 U.S.C. §102 (prior art novelty)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure evaluating statutory compliance on Section 102 (prior art / novelty compliance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to track quality of prior art/novelty determinations by examiners; includes historical targets and FY2023 actual (96.0%, Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent statutory compliance metric — 35 U.S.C. §103 (non-obviousness / prior art)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure evaluating statutory compliance on Section 103 (prior art / obviousness determinations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses examiner compliance in making non-obviousness rejections and determinations; shows FY2023 actual (92.2%, Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent statutory compliance metric — 35 U.S.C. §112 (written description / claims / 112(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure evaluating statutory compliance on Section 112 (35 U.S.C. §112(a), (b), including (a)/(b) rejections related to 35 U.S.C. §112(f)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors written description, enablement, definiteness, and claim construction/means-plus-function compliance; FY2023 actual (94.4%, Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark average first action pendency (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: KPI measuring the average number of months from filing to the first office action for a trademark application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks timeliness of first substantive action; includes historical values and targets (FY2023 actual 8.5 months, Met). Used for measuring operational timeliness in Trademark examining.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark average total pendency (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: KPI measuring the average total number of months from filing to final disposition/registration for a trademark application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitors end-to-end timeliness in trademark processing; FY2023 actual 14.6 months (Not Met), with target adjustments for subsequent years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark first action compliance rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure of compliance for first office actions in trademark examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates quality and correctness of initial examination decisions; FY2023 actual 96.8% (Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark final compliance rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent measure that evaluates all issues involved in making a final substantive decision on the registrability of a mark; evaluates quality based on decision-making, search strategy, evidence, and writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a trademark quality metric; FY2023 actual 98.6% versus 97.0% target (Exceeded). The measure explicitly assesses decision-making, search strategy, evidence use, and clarity/quality of writing in final office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of prioritized countries for which IP country teams have made progress (three-of-four criteria)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of prioritized countries where IP country teams have made progress on at least three of four performance criteria: (a) institutional improvements of IP office administration for advancing IP rights; (b) institutional improvements of IP enforcement entities; (c) improvements in IP laws and regulations; (d) establishment of government-to-government cooperative mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outcome measure for international engagement and capacity building; tracks progress by country against the four sub-criteria. FY2023 actual exceeded target (100% vs 66%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of people trained on best practices to protect and enforce IP
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of people, including foreign government officials and U.S. stakeholders, trained on best practices to protect and enforce IP (output metric).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks Global Intellectual Property Academy (GIPA) training reach and capacity-building efforts; FY2023 actual 10,126 vs target 5,000 (Exceeded). Includes both domestic stakeholders and foreign officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of customers indicating positive satisfaction with designated priority services — Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcome CX metric: percentage of customers who indicate positive satisfaction when seeking assistance when filing a patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey-based customer experience KPI reported quarterly; FY2023 actual 82% (Met). Methodology changes required target adjustments in subsequent years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of customers indicating positive satisfaction with designated priority services — Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcome CX metric: percentage of customers who indicate positive satisfaction when filing an initial application form for a trademark registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Survey-based customer experience KPI; FY2023 actual 80% vs target 70% (Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of customers who indicate the employees they interacted with were helpful — Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Customer experience outcome: percent of patent customers who indicate USPTO employees they interacted with were helpful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to assess staff responsiveness and service quality; FY2023 actual 85% vs target 82% (Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of customers who indicate the employees they interacted with were helpful — Trademarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Customer experience outcome: percent of trademark customers who indicate USPTO employees they interacted with were helpful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses staff helpfulness in trademark services; FY2023 actual 86% vs target 75% (Exceeded).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of customers who trust the USPTO to grant patents and register trademarks in accordance with U.S. laws and regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: New CX outcome metric (per OMB Circular A-11 Section 280) measuring public trust that the USPTO grants patents and registers trademarks in accordance with laws and regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduced to align with government-wide trust question; targets set for FY2024 and FY2025 at 65%. Data for FY2023 not available; metric intended to be comparable across agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance measurement framework components (Objectives, Strategies, KPIs)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Strategic Plan defines three components for each strategic goal: Objectives (measurable, specific initiatives to accomplish a goal), Strategies (targeted activities to accomplish objectives), and KPIs (change indicators used to monitor and measure progress toward each objective).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes how the USPTO develops performance indicators and links budget, strategies, and targets; subject-matter experts review and adjust measures during budget formulation and senior leadership tracks performance quarterly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark final decision quality components
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality of a final substantive decision is evaluated based on decision-making, search strategy, evidence, and writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in assessing the 'Trademark final compliance rate' KPI; demonstrates the sub-dimensions reviewers examine when evaluating trademark final office actions for quality and correctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Data Visualization and evidence-based decisionmaking
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO uses a Data Visualization Center and evidence-based processes (per Foundations for Evidence-Based Policymaking Act of 2018) to inform KPI selection, targets, and performance reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject-matter experts review metrics for adequacy, senior leadership monitors quarterly, and results feed into budget and strategic planning. Indicates expectation of data provenance and validation for KPIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance indicator documentation (Indicator class, type, source, description)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each indicator the APPR documents Program Activity, Lead Office, Indicator Class (Current/Recurring), Type (Outcome/Output), Source, Description, FY results, Performance Information Gaps, and historical table of targets vs actuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the standardized metadata the USPTO expects for each KPI to ensure transparency and verifiability of performance measures (examples shown for multiple indicators in Appendix A).
